caption: Firewall Rule Evaluation
description: The Firewall Rule Evaluation object describes a reported evaluation of a firewall rule, including its properties, match context, and action and disposition. The action and disposition apply to this evaluation and do not imply the event-level outcome.
name: firewall_rule_evaluation

action.description: The normalized caption of action_id. When action_id is 99 (Other), this attribute contains the source-specific action.

action_id.description: The normalized action reported for this firewall rule evaluation. An unknown action may still correspond to a known disposition. Refer to disposition_id for the outcome of this evaluation.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The action is unknown. The disposition may still be known.

1.caption: Allowed
1.description: The activity was allowed by this rule evaluation.

2.caption: Denied
2.description: The activity was denied by this rule evaluation.

3.caption: Observed
3.description: The activity was observed, but neither explicitly allowed nor denied by this rule evaluation.

4.caption: Modified
4.description: The activity was modified, adjusted, or corrected by this rule evaluation.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The action is not mapped. See the action attribute, which contains the source-specific action.

disposition.description: The normalized caption of disposition_id. When disposition_id is 99 (Other), this attribute contains the source-specific disposition.

disposition_id.description: The normalized outcome reported for this firewall rule evaluation. This disposition does not imply the event-level disposition.

19.caption: Alert
19.description: The rule evaluation detected a threat and produced a notification without itself blocking the activity. Other rule evaluations may determine the event-level outcome.
